title: Decision Response Guide
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: An interactive guide to the next steps and deadlines for every kind of admission decision: acceptances, Early Decision outcomes, deferrals, waitlists, denials, and offers for a different program or term.

learningObjectives: Students will select the decision they received and carry out the correct next steps, including deadlines, for acceptances, denials, deferrals, waitlists, and Early Decision outcomes.

keyQuestions: What should you do first when an Early Decision offer isn't affordable?
Why is depositing at two colleges a problem?
How can you keep a denial in perspective?
commonMisconceptions: A deferral is a polite denial.
You can hold deposits at several colleges until you decide.
assessmentOpportunities: Students list the correct next steps and deadline for three different decisions without the guide.
